text: Yes, the 2022 tree-cover loss was detected using Sentinel-2 imagery. The Hansen GFC data (which includes Sentinel-2 observations) confirmed a 0.6 ha loss within the asset boundary that year. This was corroborated by the JRC GFC2020 reference map, which agreed on the full event area being forested in 2020. The loss exceeded the minimum detectable size (0.5 ha) and was observed in subsequent years, meeting the evidence standards. The asset remained mostly forested, with native forest covering 0.5 ha of the 17.6 ha property.
